name: greycollar
description: GreyCollar is a supervised agentic AI platform designed to automate tasks, manage workflows, and provide insights.
author: GreyCollar Team

scripts.predev: rm -rf dashboard/node_modules/.vite && cd ./mcp && bun run db:reset
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "events,main,api,dashboard,communication" "bun run dev:events" "bun run server.js" "bun run dev:api" "bun run dev:dashboard" "bun run dev:communication"
scripts.install: bun run install:api && bun run install:dashboard && bun run install:communication
scripts.test: bun run test:api && bun run test:dashboard
scripts.build: bun run build:dashboard && bun run build:api && bun run build:communication
scripts.docker:local:build: bun run build && bun run build:prod && docker compose -f local/docker-compose.local.yml build
scripts.docker:local: bun run docker:local:build && bun run docker:local:up
scripts.serve: concurrently -n "main,api,dashboard" "bun run server.js" "bun run serve:api" "bunx @nucleoidai/http-server start --port 5173"
